title: Contents Packout & Storage Floor Protection Charge for Newly Finished Floors at Pack-Back
content:
Newly finished floors are protected while Contents Packout & Storage boxes come back. On the pack-back box line of a return, the lead being the calendar days from the substantial completion date of the company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address to the job's returned date: **when that lead is zero or more and no more than the fresh-finish days, each box brought back carries the fresh-finish floor protection; when it is more than the fresh-finish days, each box brought back carries the settled-finish floor protection; when no substantial completion date is recorded on the contract read, or the completion date falls after the returned date, no floor protection is charged.**

The company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is the one at that address on the job's own claim file, or with no claim file when the job has none, and among those the one furthest along, taking a closed contract first, then a final invoiced, substantially complete, in construction, permitted, signed and proposed one in that order; a cancelled contract is never read; the company keeps one rebuild contract per claim file and address, added scope for the same claim and address being written as a change order on it, so no two contracts share that place in the order.

## Floor protection per box

| Lead from the Reconstruction contract's substantial completion date to the returned date | Floor protection per box brought back |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 days (no more than the fresh-finish days) | 1.40 (fresh-finish) |
| more than 30 days | 0.70 (settled-finish) |
| no substantial completion date on the contract read | none |
| completion date after the returned date | none |

## Boundary cases (abstract dates)

- Completed and returned on the same day: lead 0, fresh-finish, 1.40 per box.
- Returned 30 days after completion: fresh-finish, 1.40 per box.
- Returned 31 days after completion: settled-finish, 0.70 per box.
- Completion recorded one day after the return: no floor protection.
